SELECT NVL(rum.application_id,1) AS application_id , NVL(rum.responsibility_id,1) AS responsibility_id , NVL(rum.responsibility_key,rm.role_code) AS responsibility_key , rm.role_name AS responsibility_name , rum.name AS employee_name , rum.employee_num , rum.team , rum.email_address , rum.description AS employee_desc , NVL(rum.section,'KR') AS section , NVL(rum.domain,rm.system_code) AS domain , NVL(rum.org,'LGDKR') AS org , NVL(rum.txn_flag,'I') AS txn_flag , NVL(rum.intf_flag,'N') AS intf_flag , NVL(rum.attribute1,'N') AS mail_send_flag , rum.attribute8 AS resp_kor_desc , rum.attribute9 AS resp_chn_desc , rum.attribute10 AS resp_eng_desc FROM LGCOM_ROLE_M rm , XXLGE_RESP_USER_MASTER rum WHERE rm.role_code = rum.responsibility_key(+) AND rm.system_code = rum.domain(+) AND rum.attribute2(+) = 'BizWeb' /* ERP Responsibility와 동일한 Role은 system에서 권한부여하므로 제외(BizWeb만 적용). */ /* Admin권한,Common, SM권한은 Super User Mapping에서 제외. */ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'x' FROM LGCOM_CODE_TYPE_CODE_C lc , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C lcc WHERE lc.code_type_code = lcc.code_type_code AND lc.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_SUPER_USER_EXCLUDE_ROLE' AND lc.use_flag = 'Y' AND lcc.use_flag = 'Y' AND lcc.common_code = rm.role_code AND (lcc.apply_start_date IS NULL OR lcc.apply_start_date < SYSDATE + 1) AND (lcc.apply_end_date IS NULL OR lcc.apply_end_date > SYSDATE - 1))
AND UPPER(rm.role_name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{roleName}) || '%'
AND UPPER(rum.description) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{employeeName}) || '%'
AND rm.system_code = #{systemCode}
AND rum.employee_num IS NOT NULL AND rum.team IS NOT NULL AND rum.employee_num IS NOT NULL
AND rum.employee_num IS NULL AND rum.team IS NULL AND rum.employee_num IS NULL
AND rum.attribute1 = #{mailControl}
ORDER BY rum.name NULLS LAST, rm.system_code, rm.role_name, rum.intf_flag
mapper.update: MERGE INTO XXLGE_RESP_USER_MASTER a USING ( SELECT #{applicationId} AS application_id , #{responsibilityId} AS responsibility_id , #{responsibilityKey} AS responsibility_key , #{responsibilityName} AS responsibility_name , #{employeeName} AS name , #{employeeNum} AS employee_num , #{team} AS team , #{emailAddress} AS email_address , #{employeeDesc} AS description , #{section} AS section , #{domain} AS domain , #{org} AS org , #{txnFlag} AS txn_flag , #{intfFlag} AS intf_flag , #{mailSendFlag} AS attribute1 , 'BizWeb' AS attribute2 , #{respKorDesc} AS attribute8 , #{respChnDesc} AS attribute9 , #{respEngDesc} AS attribute10 , #{sessionUserId} AS user_id FROM DUAL ) b ON (a.responsibility_id = b.responsibility_id AND a.responsibility_key = b.responsibility_key AND a.section = b.section) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(application_id,responsibility_id,responsibility_key,responsibility_name,name, employee_num,team,email_address,description,section,domain, org,txn_flag,intf_flag,attribute1,attribute2,attribute8,attribute9, attribute10,created_by,creation_date,last_updated_by,last_update_date) VALUES(b.application_id,b.responsibility_id,b.responsibility_key,b.responsibility_name,b.name, b.employee_num,b.team,b.email_address,b.description,b.section,b.domain, b.org,b.txn_flag,b.intf_flag,b.attribute1,b.attribute2,b.attribute8,b.attribute9, b.attribute10,b.user_id,SYSDATE,b.user_id,SYSDATE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET responsibility_name = b.responsibility_name , name = b.name , employee_num = b.employee_num , team = b.team , email_address = b.email_address , description = b.description , domain = b.domain , attribute1 = b.attribute1 , attribute8 = b.attribute8 , attribute9 = b.attribute9 , attribute10 = b.attribute10 , last_update_date = SYSDATE , last_updated_by = b.user_id
